name: FR 2052a Validate then Classify Daily
outcome: Linear two-step chain for FR 2052a daily liquidity reporting. Step 1 runs the Appendix II-a/II-b/II-c/II-d edit-check rule set against caller-supplied rows, producing a gate_status and a named list of failing edit_ids. Step 2 buckets inflows/outflows by product/maturity against a caller-supplied Appendix IV-style boundary table. Both steps always run; the edit-check result is advisory context for the classification, not a routing gate.
